title: The orientation of an integer multiplicity triple along a bi-Lipschitz parametrized piece of its carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n). Let F : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |F(a) − F(a')| for a, a' ∈ B, F differentiable with injective derivative at every point of B, and F(B) ⊆ M. Then the map b ↦ ξ(F(b)) is a.e. strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to B, and for Lebesgue-a.e. b ∈ B, ξ(F(b)) is a unit orientation of the n-plane range DF(b) (IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient (F b)) (range (fderiv ℝ F b))).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → F '' B ⊆ R.carrier → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun b => R.orient (F b)) (volume.restrict B) ∧ ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient (F b)) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F b : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
